# CleanPaths

> CleanPaths is a free, privacy-first browser-based file conversion toolkit for makers. It converts PNG, JPG, SVG and screenshots into cut-ready DXF/SVG files for Cricut, laser cutters and CNC — all processing happens locally in your browser, files never leave your device.

## Tools

- [PNG to DXF Converter](https://cleanpaths.io/png-to-dxf/): Turn PNG images into cut-ready DXF files, locally in your browser
- [JPG to DXF Converter](https://cleanpaths.io/jpg-to-dxf/): Turn client photos of logos into cut files
- [SVG to DXF Converter](https://cleanpaths.io/svg-to-dxf-converter/): Convert SVG to DXF in R12 & R2000 formats, units included
- [Screenshot to SVG](https://cleanpaths.io/screenshot-to-svg/): Clean vector output from any UI screenshot
- [JFIF to JPG Converter](https://cleanpaths.io/jfif-to-jpg/): Repackage JFIF images as standard JPG, free, no upload

## Portuguese / Português

- [Conversor de JFIF para JPG](https://cleanpaths.io/pt/jfif-para-jpg/): Converta JFIF para JPG grátis, direto no navegador, sem upload

## Use-case guides

- [For Cricut Sellers](https://cleanpaths.io/for/cricut-sellers/): Cut-ready SVG & DXF files for Cricut sellers
- [For Embroidery](https://cleanpaths.io/for/embroidery/): From image to embroidery — honest prep, human digitizers
- [Samples: Before / After](https://cleanpaths.io/samples/): See real conversion results side by side

## Pricing & policies

- [Pricing](https://cleanpaths.io/pricing/): Simple, one-time pricing — free tier included
- [Privacy Policy](https://cleanpaths.io/privacy/): No uploads, no servers, no accounts — files stay on your device
- [Terms of Service](https://cleanpaths.io/terms/)
- [Cookie Policy](https://cleanpaths.io/cookies/): No cookies used, no banner needed
- [Refund Policy](https://cleanpaths.io/refund/)

## About

- Privacy-first: all conversion runs 100% client-side; no file ever leaves the browser
- Free tier: 10 conversions per day, no account required
- Deterministic converters (not generative AI): output is traceable and reproducible
